title: Scrubbing a recording shows what the zoom does at that frame
goal: When you scrub through a recording that has zooms, the picture shows exactly what the zoom will show at each frame, the same as during playback. Today the zoom only appears while playing, so you cannot check a zoom by dragging the playhead.
notes:
User's words: "with regards to zoom, it works, but not when I'm scrubbing the video. It only shows the zoom effect when i play. I'd like to be able to scrub the video and see what the zoom box will do at any given frame."

SUSPECT, not reproduced: EditorState.swift:4501-4503 calls withZoomInHandUnzoomed after drawn(atTimeMS:), stripping zoomWindow whenever showsZoomBox, which is selectedZoom != nil && !isDocumentPlaying && zoomInHand != nil (EditorState+Zoom.swift:352-363). addZoom selects the new zoom (EditorState+Zoom.swift:108) and scrubbing never deselects it (only letGoOfZoom: empty Zoom lane click ZoomLane.swift:201, box handlers, Escape). So right after Add Zoom / Suggest Zooms every scrub shows the unzoomed picture with the box. The normal render path does apply the zoom while scrubbing (DocumentTime.drawn -> withZoomShown, PhotonzCore/DocumentTime.swift:237-241; DocumentRenderer.swift:1117). Trap: the unzoomed-with-box view exists on purpose so the box can be edited; do not just delete it, the person still needs to place the box. Secondary, unverified: MovieFrames.swift:174 reads scrub frames at a zoom-dependent size, may affect sharpness.

Shipped task this extends: a-zoom-region-that-frames-a-spot-and-can-follow (did not mention scrubbing).

DONE NOTES: framing state is EditorState.zoomFraming (EditorState.swift, documentTimeMS didSet clears it); showsZoomBox = zoomOwnsPicture && zoomFraming (EditorState+Zoom.swift). Canvas flag zoomOwnsPicture + zoomFramesOnPress closure (CanvasView/CanvasPointerCue). Walk actions expectZoomBoxDown, expectZoomScrubMatchesExport, expectZoomEasesFrameByFrame (PlaytestZoom.swift).
acceptance: Reproduce first: add a zoom, scrub across it with the transport stopped, and record what the canvas shows (photograph it) before changing anything
Scrubbing across a zoom (selected or not) shows the zoomed picture at every frame, matching what playback and export show at the same time to within 1% of pixels, MEASURED and written in the audit

There is still a clear way to edit the zoom's box: the person can see and drag the area the zoom frames without the scrub preview being wrong (for example the box is edited while the picture shows the result, or editing the box is its own clear state that scrubbing leaves). The chosen design is described in the audit
Easing in and out of a zoom is visible frame by frame while scrubbing
A walk at Next defaults scrubs through a zoom with it selected and with it not selected and photographs both
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced 2026-10-03: walk /tmp/zrepro/repro-walk.json (sample recording, Add Zoom at 2.0s, clickRuler 2.35s and 3.5s, zoom still picked). Window capture 3-scrub-hold-sc.png at 3.5s, inside the 200% hold: canvas shows the WHOLE picture with the 200% box, not the zoom. Cause confirmed as the suspect: withZoomInHandUnzoomed strips zoomWindow whenever a zoom is picked and stopped, and Add Zoom picks the new zoom and scrubbing never lets it go.
owns these walks: scrubbing-shows-the-zoom-walk, a-click-on-the-zoom-bar-frames-it-walk, a-zoom-follows-the-cursor-walk, framing-a-zoom-shows-one-box-walk

Adversarial review before building: a Premiere/FCP user scrubs to check an effect; FCP shows crop/Ken Burns boxes only inside an explicit edit state. The trap in the notes is real: the box view is how a zoom is placed. Design: framing is its own state (EditorState.zoomFraming). Add Zoom, Suggest Zooms, a click on the bar, or a click on the picture while a zoom is picked put the box up; any playhead move (documentTimeMS didSet: scrub, ruler, keys, play) takes it down. With the box down the zoom stays picked and still owns presses on the picture (canvas flag renamed zoomBoxUp -> zoomOwnsPicture), so the clip's handles never appear under a picked zoom; a press on the clip puts the box back up (pointer: pointing hand, playtest cue 'frame'), a press off it lets the zoom go.

Verified: scrubbing-shows-the-zoom-walk at Next defaults (no flags) ok: expectZoomScrubMatchesExport picked and let go, 0.0% of pixels apart from export at 2175/2350/2525/3500/4650 ms (zoom changes 2.7-35.3%); expectZoomEasesFrameByFrame 21 frames in, 21 out, window width moving every frame (reads playtestLastDrawn, the document actually handed to the canvas). a-click-on-the-zoom-bar-frames-it-walk ok (windowClick on the bar, needs the Mac). All 10 zoom walks ok via playtest-all zoom. Scripts/test.sh: 11044 tests passed. Left rough, not filed (no defect, nothing a person is stopped by): nothing but the pointer says clicking the zoomed picture frames it; clicking the ruler at the playhead's own moment leaves the box up; during playback with a zoom picked the clip's handles show (pre-existing).
